sample_rule: first16 sorted by SHA256(enrichment-audit-v1 + skill_id), independent of outcomes

denominators.supported_weak_unsupported: accepted items in reviewed documents, mutually exclusive
denominators.empty: reviewed documents with zero accepted items; pending documents are not zero-valued observations

blindness: For this semantic audit, no real evaluation query text, qrels, rankings, or retrieval metrics were read. Generator pseudoqueries are the output under review. Earlier structural cohort/qrel QA is separate.

criteria.supported: Requested action or capability is grounded in the full source actually supplied to the generator; the quotation alone is not treated as entailment.
criteria.weak_or_generic: Source-grounded action, but wording drops a material scope or platform discriminator, or is excessively generic. This is not a demonstrated retrieval failure.
criteria.unsupported: Invented capability or contradiction of the supplied source, including unsupported specificity. Questions about limits are not positive claims that a limit can be bypassed.
criteria.empty: Document has zero accepted intents and zero accepted pseudoqueries.

limitations: Single reviewer, 16 fixed sampled documents, incomplete until pending records are reviewed.
Evaluates support relative to the truncated provided source, not original full corpus or external factual correctness.
Does not establish retrieval utility, safety, scientific correctness, or absence of unsupported statements in the other documents.
No prompts, output filters, generation outputs, or retrieval settings were changed.
